# Tensorcraft

> Interactive, story-driven ML education for JavaScript engineers. Learn browser-based machine learning through JavaScript, TypeScript, and tools you already know.

## What is Tensorcraft?

Tensorcraft is a web application that teaches machine learning to JavaScript developers. It uses a unique "bridge" methodology - mapping familiar JavaScript concepts (like useState, Array.map, fetch) to their ML equivalents (model weights, tensor ops, inference API). Each course is a narrative world where learners build real ML models that run entirely in the browser using TensorFlow.js.

## Key Facts

- 5 worlds, each with 11 modules and 55 lessons (~22 hours per world)
- 275 total lessons across all worlds
- 295 interactive coding exercises with in-browser Sandpack editor
- 50+ JavaScript-to-ML concept bridges
- Per-world one-time purchase: $59
- Module 1 of every world is free - no account required
- Light and dark mode, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
- Built with Next.js 15, TensorFlow.js, Supabase, Stripe

## The 5 Worlds

1. Deep Orbit (Space) - Time-Series & Signals - Build a deep-space signal classifier with RNNs/LSTMs
2. Neon Protocol (Cyberpunk) - Computer Vision - Build an urban anomaly detector with CNNs
3. Signal Ward (Medical) - NLP & Text Intelligence - Build a clinical text assistant with transformers
4. Nova Canvas (Creative AI) - Multimodal & Generative - Build a creative assistant with GANs/diffusion
5. Terra Grid (Industrial) - Edge AI & Production ML - Build an edge monitoring system with MLOps

## Who It's For

JavaScript engineers who want to add machine learning to their skillset without switching to Python: in the browser, in Node, in React. Each bridge analogy maps a JS/TS concept to its ML equivalent.
